verdict.rationale: Docs show org-level control over API key issuance (approve/decline prompts, ability to restrict developers from creating keys) and Enterprise-tier role-based permissions/managed policy settings, which touch on credential governance, but there is no documented mechanism to issue a scoped or least-privilege API key/token specifically for an agent's use (e.g., limited-scope keys, per-agent permission boundaries tied to API credentials). Missing for 10: explicit scoped/limited-permission API key creation flow for agents, documentation of credential scoping granularity, and independent verification that such least-privilege keys work as intended.
